product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic provides a content-orchestration platform that helps enterprises, archives, and government agencies manage, govern, and orchestrate digital and media assets at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page describes the content-orchestration platform, its digital and media asset management capabilities, and its audience of brands, archives, and government agencies. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/about

pricing_page.notes: The reviewed homepage navigation and footer direct visitors to demos rather than a pricing page and contain no pricing link. The /pricing URL also returned no readable page. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The homepage features customer stories for Lionsgate and A+E Global Media. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/ | named_customers.0: Lionsgate is featured in a homepage customer story. | named_customers.1: A+E Global Media is featured in a homepage customer story.

employee_band.notes: The reported employee count of 278 falls within 201-500. LinkedIn-associated headcount is an estimate rather than a verified payroll count. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/orange-logic

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly lists Irvine, California as headquarters. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/320369 | hq_country: The company profile identifies Irvine, California as headquarters, and its location record explicitly names the United States. Sources: https://linkedin.com/company/320369 and https://linkedin.com/company/orange-logic

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists Founded 1998. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/320369

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog index presents DAM advice, customer outcomes, and product or marketing content. It does not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how Orange Logic itself is built; technical-sounding titles alone do not satisfy that criterion. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/blog/all

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal links to API reference documentation, core-feature endpoints, and DataTable APIs, establishing multiple documentation sections. Source: https://developer.orangelogic.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Applied AI Product Engineer posting includes an application action and meets the title criterion. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/jobs/global-applied-ai-product-engineer-orange-logic

model_provider.notes: The announcement explicitly identifies NVIDIA Nemotron open models as being embedded in Agent Studio. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/orange-logic-brings-nvidia-nemotron-to-agent-studio-advancing-governed-ai-agents-for-enterprise-content

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The homepage publicly claims all four named compliance credentials; these are reported as company claims. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/ | compliance_certs.0: The homepage explicitly names SOC 2 in its compliance claims. | compliance_certs.1: The homepage explicitly names ISO 27001 in its compliance claims. | compliance_certs.2: The homepage explicitly names HIPAA in its compliance claims. | compliance_certs.3: The homepage explicitly names GDPR in its compliance claims.

Sources: https://www.sagemount.com/news/bregal-sagemount-announces-strategic-growth-investment-in-orange-logic and https://www.cbinsights.com/company/orange-logic/financials | funding_amount_usd: The funding history describes the May 2023 private-equity investment as an undisclosed amount, so no supported USD amount can be supplied. Sources: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/orange-logic/financials and https://tracxn.com/d/companies/orangelogic/__D9NVOUdnIQotwFvHfBdFdu6be-9zNDnP1bcWWHTidig/funding-and-investors

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live US Account Executive posting includes an application link and meets the specified sales-role criterion. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/jobs/account-executive

launched_6mo.notes: The September 8, 2026 announcement introduces NVIDIA Nemotron integration into Agent Studio, a substantive AI capability announcement within the six-month window. The evidence establishes the announcement, not deployment to every customer. Source: https://www.orangelogic.com/dam-blog/orange-logic-brings-nvidia-nemotron-to-agent-studio-advancing-governed-ai-agents-for-enterprise-content

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Shawnna Sumaoang's profile dates the start of her Orange Logic Vice President of Marketing role to August 2026, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/shawnnasumaoang
